a.lede: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has been hit with a record $6.3 billion hack.
a.title: Binance hacked for an estimated $6.3 billion in record crypto theft

b.lede: The FBI has confirmed that North Korean state-sponsored hackers known as TraderTraitor were behind the $6.3 billion crypto-theft attack on Binance, making it the largest cryptocurrency heist on record. [...]
b.title: FBI links $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist to North Korean hackers
